args.body: Hi Dora! I recently visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com) and wanted to share some feedback. The site has a clean, simple design, which is a great starting point. However, it's currently quite minimal — it only contains a brief introduction and your email address. I'd suggest adding more content, such as a short bio about who you are, your skills or interests, and maybe some projects or achievements you'd like to showcase. Including a bit more personality and detail would make your website much more engaging and useful for visitors. Keep up the good work!

Hi Eve! I just checked out your blog (www.eve-blog.com) and wanted to share some feedback. I love that your blog highlights your favorite hobby — hiking! It's a wonderful way to connect with readers who share similar interests. I'd encourage you to expand on this by sharing your favorite trails, hiking tips, gear recommendations, or stories and photos from your adventures. Adding regular posts would make your blog even more engaging and give visitors a reason to come back. Great start — happy hiking!
